en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Ja’far, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man came over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he said, ‘O Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>! What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding the chess which the people are playing with?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> informed me<sup>asws</sup> from Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, from Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who spoke and his speech was for other than the Mention of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, it would be vain, and the one who was silent, so his silence was for other than remembering Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, is would be forgetfulness’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> was silent, so the man stood up and left’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Musa ibn al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ja‘far who has said the following: “Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, that once a man came to abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and said, ‘O abu Ja‘far, what do you say about chess with which people play?’

He (the Imam) said, ‘My father narrated to me from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from al-Husayn ibn Ali from ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhim al- Salam. He (the Imam) has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “If one speaks and his speech is something other than speaking of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, he is doing something useless. If one is silent and his silence is for something other than Allah he is forgetful.’” He (the Imam) then remained calm and the man left.’”
